concepts.title: Parity of Numbers
concepts.definition: Any even number can be arranged in pairs without any leftovers. An odd number is one more than a collection of pairs.
concepts.key_idea: Parity denotes the property of a number being even or odd.

concepts.title: Parity of Sums and Differences
concepts.definition: The sum of two even numbers is even; the sum of two odd numbers is even; the sum of an even and an odd number is odd.
concepts.formula: even + even = even; odd + odd = even; even + odd = odd
concepts.key_idea: The parity of a sum depends on the parity of the individual addends.

concepts.title: Parity of Grid Squares

concepts.key_idea: The total is even if at least one dimension is even; it is odd only if both dimensions are odd.
